title: First live lab bench run: do model item centres still pick the tapped problem?
body:
## Summary
npm run bench -- --live has never run; the replay only proves the bench, not the model.

## Description
vision-lab B landed a replay-only bench (tools/lab-bench.cjs). The question it was built for - whether the phone tap still selects the right problem from the model-reported centres, where the lab ring scored 16/16 - needs one live run against the local vision model. Operator-only act: it spends model calls on the operator machine.

## Flow
- cd desk && npm run bench -- --live
- read the "tap selects" row against 16/16

## Expected impact
Decides whether the phone tap is trustworthy on real reads; nothing breaks.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - tap selection on real model reads
Before: unknown (replay reads ground truth)
After: one live run decides
Method: experiment - not run: live model calls are the operator call
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Run live-ui-test on a device: /health, off-screen undo, frame clear
body:
## Summary
Three telestrator changes landed today are proven by JVM tests only; no TV device was attached.

## Description
health-pin (942925d), pen-core A (Metric) and pen-core B (frame clear, off-screen undo; live-ui-test section 9b) were never run on a Fire TV. Operator-only act: needs the device and adb.

## Flow
- scripts/dev.ps1 to install
- node tools/live-ui-test.mjs (reads the PIN from logcat now)
- check 9b off-screen undo and the frame clear

## Expected impact
Confirms the pen changes on the real overlay; could reveal a tv-app regression the JVM lane cannot see.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - pen changes hold on device
Before: JVM tests green, device unrun
After: live-ui-test green on device
Method: experiment - no device in this session
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: The context map misses ~40 source files added since 2026-09-23
body:
## Summary
context-map.json predates the module redesigns; maths/, essay/, landing/, keys and rows, jobs, pairing, the uat verdict and ledger are in no context.

## Description
Unmapped: desk/src/maths/*, desk/src/essay/*, desk/src/landing/*, desk/src/tv/{keys,landingRows,mathsRows,sheetRows,recapRows}.ts, desk/src/lib/desk/{job,select}.ts, desk/src/lib/english/{view,help,turn,review}.ts, desk/src/lib/session/pairing.ts, desk/src/proxy.ts, uat/driver/{surface,recertify,verdict,ledger}.cjs, core HealthBody/PenConversation/TransportPlan/Metric, and ~15 tools suites. coverage.mjs sizes contexts from the map, so the picker under-sizes every desk context and sweeps read these files only when a scout is told. Editing the map is an architecture act; new contexts (math-buddy, essay-master, landing) are the likely shape.

## Flow
- node coverage.mjs --challenge lists tv-surface at 10 files
- git ls-files desk/src shows the unmapped modules

## Expected impact
Sweeps and the picker see the product as it is.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - tracked source files in no context
Before: ~40
After: 0
Method: probe - diffed git ls-files against every file_paths entry
Result: better
Gate: architecture

title: screens.tsx and MathsTV/EssayTV import each other
body:
## Summary
tv-surface B made screens.tsx import from MathsTV and EssayTV, which already import screens.tsx.

## Description
A render-time-only cycle: it builds clean today, but any module-level use on either side becomes a load-order error, and it ties the shell to both modules. Fix: move the shared recap tile pieces into a leaf module both import.

## Flow
- grep imports in desk/src/tv/screens.tsx, desk/src/maths/MathsTV.tsx, desk/src/essay/EssayTV.tsx

## Expected impact
Removes a latent load-order trap; no visible change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - import cycles between the shell and modules
Before: 2
After: 0
Method: probe - builder report plus grep
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Menu on the landing spends a model call via /api/memory
body:
## Summary
Pressing Menu (M) on the landing opens Tonight, done, which calls /api/memory and so the text engine.

## Description
A recap a learner may open by accident costs a model call each time. Either cache the evening summary per session or draw the recap from the history lines alone - the tiles already parse them (parseDetail).

## Flow
- landing, press M
- POST /api/memory -> text engine call

## Expected impact
Fewer model calls; the recap opens instantly.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - model calls per recap open
Before: 1
After: 0 on a repeat open
Method: simulation - builder note, not measured
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Phone-only Linga controls remain outside the 15 tested states
body:
## Summary
With the TV on Linga home while a conversation or level check runs on the phone, the phone still draws controls the view does not offer.

## Description
linga-controls (ac2a547) brought the 15 tested states to 0 phone-only controls; the detector still reports some in the TV-home / phone-busy combination. Extend the surface states and route those controls through view.ts. Also: surface.cjs counts a disabled action with a disabled control as no control, which is noise in LT coverage.

## Flow
- TV on Linga home
- phone mid-conversation
- surfaceOf() reports phoneOnly > 0

## Expected impact
One source of truth in every reachable state; cleaner LT coverage.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - phone-only controls across reachable states
Before: >0 outside the 15 states
After: 0
Method: probe - surface.cjs detector, per builder
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The factor item leak "3 and 4" is not caught by leaks()
body:
## Summary
vision-lab A extended rules/maths leaks(), but the lab leak term for the factor problem (its roots as "3 and 4") is not covered.

## Description
vision/poc_hints.py lists "3 and 4" as a leak for the factor item; leaksByForm handles equations and brackets, not a spoken root pair. A hint saying "try 3 and 4" would reach the TV.

## Flow
- hint for x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0 phrased "try 3 and 4"
- leaks() -> false

## Expected impact
Closes the last lab-listed leak shape.

## Evaluation
Claim: policy-tighten - lab leak terms caught
Before: all but 1
After: all
Method: probe - builder report
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
